heading: Built for real
description: Tag RoBo Tech features combine tagging software and field process so teams can prove presence close gaps and keep FAR programmes moving.
body: Every feature page is designed to connect technology choice to operational outcomes. Whether you need long-range RFID outdoor GPS or controlled NFC checkpoints the goal stays the same: reliable identity evidence that finance and operations can act on.
bullets: Match technology to asset class environment and scan frequency
Feed reads into Footprints for registers exceptions and audits
Support pilots then expand with multi-site playbooks
aside_text: Use this feature alone or as part of a broader Tag RoBo Tech stack spanning devices software and verification.
